Question Choices: A student got 21 questions correct, which is 70% of the test. How many questions were on the test?
Hints: The known amount equals the decimal percentage times the unknown whole. Divide to find that whole.
Solution: Let W be the original whole. 70%=0.7, so 0.7×W=21. Divide: W=21÷0.7=30 questions. Check:30×0.7=21.
